name: Webian Custom Post Accordion for Elementor
author: webian

sections.description:
Custom Post Accordion for Elementor lets you display any custom post type (CPT) as a smooth, animated accordion widget — directly inside the Elementor editor with full live preview.
Whether you’re building a job listing page, an FAQ section, a team member showcase, a product catalogue, or any other content type, this widget gives you a flexible, style-ready accordion that works with your existing WordPress setup.
No shortcodes. No custom templates. Just drag and drop to configure.

Features

  • Works with any registered custom post type — dynamic dropdown auto-populates from your site
  • Ordering controls — sort by menu order, date, title, or random
  • Customisable toggle button — choose text or icon, set separate open and closed states
  • Full style controls — background colour, border, border radius, padding, gap between items
  • Typography support — connect title and content to Elementor Global Fonts and Global Colours
  • Responsive padding — separate settings for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Real-time Elementor editor preview — every style change reflects instantly

Perfect for

  • Job listings and career pages
  • FAQ and knowledge base sections
  • Team member directories
  • Product or service catalogues
  • News and announcement archives
  • Any content stored in a custom post type

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • Elementor (free) 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
    Elementor Pro is not required. The widget works with the free Elementor plugin.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  3. Click Activate Plugin
  4. Open any page in the Elementor editor and search for “Custom Post Accordion”
    Alternatively, install directly from the WordPress plugin directory:
  5. Go to Plugins → Add New
  6. Search for “Webian Custom Post Accordion”
  7. Click Install Now then Activate
sections.faq:
Does this work without Elementor Pro?

Yes. This plugin works with the free Elementor plugin. Elementor Pro is not required.

Which custom post types does it support?

All public custom post types registered on your site. The Post Type dropdown automatically lists all available CPTs — including those registered by other plugins or your theme.

Does the accordion animate smoothly?

Yes. The widget uses a CSS grid animation technique for smooth, hardware-accelerated open and close transitions.

Can I use icons for the toggle button instead of text?

Yes. The Toggle Button settings let you choose between text and icon for both the open and closed states, using the Elementor icon library.

Will my style settings update live in the Elementor editor?

Yes. All colour, typography, spacing, and border controls update the preview in real time.

Is it compatible with Elementor’s Global Colours and Global Fonts?

Yes. The Title and Toggle Button typography controls support Elementor Global Fonts and Colours.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. All user-facing strings use the text domain webian-custom-post-accordion-for-elementor.
